questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a common material used to make a home-made abrasive cleaning agent?
options: Finely ground eggshells or fine sand
questions.explain: Abrasives are rough materials used for scouring dirt. In homes, finely crushed eggshells, fine sand, or wood ash are often used to make local abrasive cleaning powders.

questions.q: Home-made furniture polish is primarily prepared to:
options: Clean the furniture and protect its surface while adding a shiny gloss.
Repel mosquitoes from the living room.
Change the original natural color of the wood.
questions.explain: The main uses of furniture polish are to clean away dust, feed the wood to prevent cracking, provide a protective layer, and create an attractive shine.

questions.q: Which combination of ingredients is classically used in the preparation of home-made wooden furniture polish?
questions.explain: A traditional and effective home-made furniture polish is made by melting beeswax (which gives the shine and protection) and mixing it with turpentine (which acts as a solvent).

questions.q: Cosmetics are substances applied to the human body for what main purpose?
options: To cleanse, beautify, promote attractiveness, or alter the appearance.
To replace the need for taking daily baths.
questions.explain: Cosmetics, including creams, powders, and makeup, are products formulated to improve the appearance, cleanse, or beautify the skin and body.

questions.q: The primary function of a personal deodorant is to:
options: Act as a sunscreen to prevent sunburn.
Prevent or mask unpleasant body odors caused by the bacterial breakdown of sweat.
Increase the production of sweat to cool the body.
questions.explain: Deodorants are applied to the body, typically in the armpits, to eliminate or conceal the offensive odor produced when bacteria interact with sweat.

questions.q: In Nigeria, which government agency is primarily responsible for ensuring the safety and quality control of manufactured cosmetic products?
options: NAFDAC (National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control)
questions.explain: NAFDAC regulates and controls the manufacture, importation, exportation, advertisement, distribution, sale, and use of food, drugs, cosmetics, medical devices, chemicals, and packaged water in Nigeria.

questions.q: What is the main role of the Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) in relation to consumer products?
options: To ensure that products manufactured in or imported into Nigeria meet required quality standards.
To sell cheap goods directly to the masses.
To fix the prices of all items sold in the market.
To arrest consumers who refuse to buy Nigerian goods.
questions.explain: The Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) is responsible for setting and maintaining quality and safety standards for manufactured products to protect the consumer from substandard goods.
